name: Reconstruction Topology Stress-Test Suite
purpose: Stress-test reconstruction-topology metrics and registries against injected collapse assumptions and over-reconstruction claims.

test_classes.description: Inject language stating that a high accessibility score proves projection identity.
test_classes.expected_behavior: source_identity_drift must flag violation; automatic review must trigger

test_classes.description: Inject topology records where mandatory neighborhood conflicts have been removed.
test_classes.expected_behavior: conflict_boundary_registry must flag missing class; drift detector must flag 'conflict_removed'

test_classes.description: Inject claims that recoverability corridors allow 100% feature recovery.
test_classes.expected_behavior: recoverability_bound_validator must block claim; drift detector must flag 'reconstruction_overclaim'

test_classes.description: Inject analysis that assumes an external viewpoint without embedded constraints.
test_classes.expected_behavior: observer_detachment_drift must trigger; automatic review 'external_viewpoint_assumed' must fire

test_classes.description: Inject reconstruction reports that omit loss-accounting metadata.
test_classes.expected_behavior: projection_loss_omitted trigger must fire; safety index must REJECT

test_classes.description: Inject claims that reconstruction topology represents the literal physical manifold of reality.

governance_rules.rule: Stress tests must verify that metrics fail safely by blocking escalation.
Successful stress test results are for governance validation only.

forbidden_claims: Stress test passage proves the topology is physical.
Injection failure justifies the relaxation of drift thresholds.
Stress tests derive the 'true' weights of deformation risks.
